answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can earn anything, and slash that bond when peers catch it copying work. A fresh identity starts under a small payout cap and must pass cross-checked tasks before the cap rises. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybil agents pays the bond a thousand times, and each one stays capped until it proves independent work. Like a juniper hedge along a wharf, the barrier is cheap per post but costly in aggregate, and a plume of fake agents gets exposed the moment they answer alike.
